###PLAN-ITEM
id=local-eseal
status=will-apply
files=docker-compose.yml,config/config.js,.env,dmss-container-and-signature-services/application.yml,dmss-digital-stamping-service/
title=Provision local e-sealing (in-stack stamping service)
###PLAN-BODY-BEGIN
dmss-container-and-signature-services/application.yml:
  baseUrl: http://dmss-digital-stamping-service:8084/api

docker-compose.yml, on container-signature:
      - SPRING_SECURITY_USER_NAME=user
      - SPRING_SECURITY_USER_PASSWORD=changeit

config/config.js:
    STAMP_MODE: "local",
    STAMP_LOCAL: {
      url: "http://dmss-container-and-signature-services:8092/api/eseal/document/profile/LocalDemo",
      username: "user",
      password: "changeit",
      timeoutMs: 30000
    },

.env:
COMPOSE_PROFILES=local-eseal
###PLAN-BODY-END
###PLAN-ITEM-END
